description: Per-sample taxonomy, provenance, and generative AI evidence audit for document pilot N=40
taxonomy_conclusion: Zero samples (0/40) have verified Generative AI provenance (e.g. diffusion, GAN, LLM inpainting). All 20 forged samples ('black') exhibit text-level digital manipulation (visual clumsy redaction, logical fraud, semantic alteration) with unverified generation provenance. All 20 authentic samples ('white') are independent pristine documents with zero paired source relationship. Therefore, this pilot strictly evaluates forgery vs pristine classification according to source labels, and cannot claim to measure AI-edited detection capability.
